* Example 1:
[Input]
```INPUT_TEXT
Slide Title: Inventory Optimization in Retail
Slide Content: Retailers face challenges in predicting demand, leading to stockouts or excess inventory. Google Cloud's AI solutions help optimize supply chain operations.
- Industry Pillar: Digital Supply Chain
- Sales Plays: Inventory Optimization, Smart Supply Chain, Demand Forecasting
- Personas: Supply Chain Director, Store Managers, Retail Analysts
- Problem: Inaccurate forecasting and legacy ERP systems lead to high carrying costs and lost sales.
- Solution: Implement Gemini-powered predictive modeling to forecast demand with 90%+ accuracy, automate stock replenishment, and optimize warehouse logistics.
- Value: Reduce excess inventory by 20%, improve fulfillment rates, and save millions in carrying costs.
- KPIs: Stockout Reduction, Inventory Turnover Ratio, Warehouse Cost Savings
- Google Differentiation: Vertex AI offers pre-built demand forecasting models that integrate with ERPs, utilizing multimodal data (weather, trends) for unmatched accuracy.
```

* Example 2:
[Input]
```INPUT_TEXT
Slide Title: Connected Customer Service in Banking
Slide Content: Banks need to modernize customer service using AI to resolve queries faster and reduce call center loads.
- Industry Pillar: Customer Experience Modernization
- Sales Plays: Agent Assist, Virtual Agents, Contact Center AI
- Personas: Head of Retail Banking, Customer Support VP, Operations Lead
- Problem: High support costs, long hold times, and low customer satisfaction due to manual call routing and legacy IVR systems.
- Solution: Deploy Contact Center AI (CCAI) to route queries, assist agents in real-time, and automate common banking transactions.
- Value: Reduce average handle time by 30%, increase self-service resolution, and improve CSAT score.
- KPIs: average handle time reduction, self-service rate, CSAT improvement
- Google Differentiation: Native integration of Gemini into Contact Center AI allows complex query resolution and automated summary generation.
```
